parent.R95_control_flaw: index-tied law and roll-fallback produced anti-correlated instead of information-removed shuffled A cues

question: Can the nontransformer width32 native core with a role-conditioned learned sidecar learn a genuinely ordered-role conditional consequence from factual action/reward alone, beating a flat native sidecar and fully trained conventional raw-cue controls on fresh early/cold and role-swap evaluations? Does a separately measured and validated deranged raw-A negative destroy conditional-law signal?

source.physical_constructor: R85._make_synthetic_world(index%512, independent SeedSequence([panel_salt,seed,index])) ONLY pure physics, then independently resample four A factors from same RNG; override original index-law and set law_a = factor_A_role1 IF factor_A_role0 positive ELSE factor_A_role2; role3 independent nuisance; original world B factors, time order and R85 rollout remain. No original R85-R95 _world/_test_world nor scored source.
source.independent_law_mechanism: a=np RNG.choice([-1,1],size=4); mux(a): a[1] if a[0]>0 else a[2]; P(law_a=+1)=.5 independent of index, public early/cold pivot, and logged action; role1<->role2 swap changes law for half of worlds when a1!=a2.
source.chosen_factual_action: CALIBRATE if ((index//4)+seed_index)%2==0 else EXPLOIT_POS, balanced action x early/cold pivot x old index-only stratum in design, but index-derived stratum is NOT a hidden law now.
source.public: original lawful R86 48-row selected timeline (not full 224 recurrent ticks), R88 pure role-extracted 5x13 actual A probe/current action, R95 pure raw 8D four noisy A responses and action/time. No hidden mux sign/law/teacher in any learned arm.
source.FIT_labels: actual observed 9-tick return under ONE chosen factual action only, never unchosen branch, hidden law, private index stratum or evaluator oracle.
source.DEV_scoring: only after all arms trained and frozen create 256 new paired physical worlds and both factual intervention returns for evaluator. OOD_SHIFT uses existing R86 pure 68/208-pivot noise/probe time shift same mux law; not unfamiliar law transfer.
source.ROLE_SWAP: after all weights frozen, fresh 256 worlds; for evaluator calculate both legal physical returns for original world and for a counterfactual world swapping A role1<->role2 factor values and recomputing true mux law, holding B/time order/noise fixed. Report policy action change conditional on true law change, accuracy on both worlds, and comparison to sorted-role-invariant negative.
source.negative_shuffle: independent seed-only random derangement within public pivot+logged-action groups for FIT/VALID; public pivot only for paired evaluator DEV/OOD, never compare to hidden target law to SELECT or modify permutation. Rejection-sample until zero fixed points within each group; no fallback rotation. Preserve chosen action/time/observed role ids but replace four A cue values with donor world.
source.source_independence_audit: measure original private law frequency across pivot/action and source index bins and donor-vs-original law alignment ONLY for audit, not learner input. Each group law-positive fraction 0.40..0.60, donor law equality fraction 0.40..0.60 on FIT/DEV/OOD; if violated, stop as invalid, never try a new shuffle or rerun scored panel.

model.native: R74 original HybridPilot_FULL width32 + R75 equivalent causal triangular TTT, original hard depth router; native main unchanged; all three native core initial tensor values equal
model.flat_sidecar: R87 identical 8D PublicValueMLP additive to original native readout
model.role_gate: Trainable generic role-conditioned selector over FOUR noisy A role cues, conditioned on ALL four observed cues through a small MLP gate and feature MLP, softmax role weighting; readout conditions on learned attended value, selected action flags and public time. No fixed conditional mux, parity sign, private law labels or teacher targets supplied; role-ordered extraction is a prior.
model.role_gate_sidecar: Same learned gate sidecar added to original native pivot readout, separate experimental readout; any gain is not proof native core independently learned role binding.
model.raw_mlp: Existing R87 PublicValueMLP 8D legal raw cue baseline
model.sorted_negative: Existing same 4801-param MLP fed four sorted noisy A cues (roles removed, action/time unchanged), fully trained
model.deranged_negative: Identical role gate architecture/params as real gate, 4 raw A cue values replaced by independent donor within public strata, original current action/returns unchanged
model.GRU: Existing R81 GRU64 on exact same 5x13 lawful role event rows, 15,233 params
model.upper: Existing R87 same-4801-param MLP fed explicitly hand-coded mux sign of observed (noisy) A cues, only diagnostic upper and never supplied to trainable role gate; not physical oracle
model.comparison_caveat: Original core, sidecars, 4801-param MLP, role gate and GRU differ in parameter count/FLOPs. SAME labeled examples, batches/optimizer updates; report param/elapsed; no formal FLOP/parameter matched native superiority claim.
